event_info.event_description: Analyze for disclosures on global pandemic risks. Look for corporate language discussing widespread impacts like supply chain disruptions, labor shortages, remote work transitions, and fundamental shifts in consumer demand.

holistic_analysis: The provided excerpt from WFC’s February 23, 2021 filing contains only boiler-plate cross-references directing readers to other sections of the report and to the prior-year Annual Report. No language in the supplied text describes, even generically, how the COVID-19 pandemic has affected or may affect the company. Because the excerpt lacks any substantive discussion of pandemic-related disruptions—such as supply-chain issues, workforce challenges, remote-work transitions, or shifts in customer demand—there is no basis for assigning a risk score. Under the Time Decay Principle, the pandemic would qualify as a recent event (0-3 years) and could warrant a high score if evidence existed, but here the absence of content overrides that potential. Consequently, the overall assessed risk from the material actually provided is effectively nonexistent.
